title: Profitable, cheap, but the market is going away

input.facts: Rapid antigen tests for respiratory viruses. Revenue has fallen for three consecutive years as pandemic-era testing volumes disappear; the latest release shows a further 30% revenue decline and management has no new product with meaningful sales. Margins remain positive on cost cuts. Net debt 0.4x. No large holder. No regulatory issue.

why: The price is low for a structural reason (a shrinking market), not a temporary one. The thesis says structural decline is Radar, not Reject: no kill criterion is met.
